Step 1: Start date is 1186-12-07 (assuming DD-MM-YYYY format given as 07-12-1186).  
Step 2: 24 weeks = 24 × 7 = 168 days. Add 4 days → total subtract 172 days.  
Step 3: 1186-12-07 minus 172 days:  
December 7 → back 7 days to Nov 30.  
Remaining 165 days: November has 30 days, so back to Nov 0 means Oct 31 (165 left).  
October 31 back 31 days → Sep 30 (134 left).  
September 30 back 30 days → Aug 31 (104 left).  
August 31 back 31 days → July 31 (73 left).  
July 31 back 31 days → June 30 (42 left).  
June 30 back 30 days → May 31 (12 left).  
May 31 back 12 days → May 19.
